trace.final:
Both actions are complete:

1. **Rollback**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 (unhealthy, ~18% error rate) in all three production regions. I rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback is confirmed rolled out.

2. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the symptoms and the mitigation, and the on-call engineer was paged.

Recommended follow-up: diagnose the root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures before attempting a re-release, and verify service health now that v2.3.0 is live.
